brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Keyhole hangers on rear face slot 1 of all three cells: accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1 – 3-cell horizontal rack hanging via keyhole mount
Hook plates on front face slot 4 of all three cells: accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 – each hex-acc-hook provides two hooks side by side (6 hooks total)

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal tool rack (-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0) joined with joint bolts. Rear face (slot 1) has keyhole hangers for wall mounting, front face (slot 4) has three hook plates providing 6 hooks for hand tools. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
